name: taxes_per_model_line
note: verifier: link read from the model-line endpoint (account.reconcile.model.line.tax_ids)
source_sql: SELECT account_reconcile_model_line_id, count(*) AS taxes, max(account_tax_id) AS last_tax FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel GROUP BY account_reconcile_model_line_id ORDER BY account_reconcile_model_line_id

name: model_lines_per_tax
note: verifier: link read from the tax endpoint (inverse of tax_ids)
source_sql: SELECT account_tax_id, count(*) AS model_lines, min(account_reconcile_model_line_id) AS first_line FROM account_reconcile_model_line_account_tax_rel GROUP BY account_tax_id ORDER BY account_tax_id
